access.label: Access
access.text: 3 min walk from Sapporo Subway Station (direct underground access){br}5 min walk from JR Sapporo Station South Exit

1.title: ParaReal Stage
1.text: Screening of “Shika The VR MUSICAL,” a real talk show, and a live crossover of real and virtual. Held after closing at Deep Tech CORE SAPPORO (free).

2.title: Matching Card Game
2.text: Write your interests on a card and introduce yourselves. Keep mingling and you may get a shot at a limited-goods lottery. Participation is optional.

3.title: Message Cards
3.text: Write a message on a small card and pin it to the board. Photos with the event hashtag are welcome.

4.title: Creator Showcase
4.text: A promo space where you can leave flyers, business cards, and postcards to share your activities.

5.title: Avatar Group Photo (Advance Program)
5.text: Group photos taken in VRChat and displayed at the real venue.

6.title: Official Goods
6.text: Official merchandise for sale, including venue exclusives. Full lineup to be announced later.

7.title: Visitor Giveaway
7.text: A raffle giveaway held during the ParaReal Creator closing ceremony.
